children: SAID ON THURSDAY IT PROPOSES CAPITAL RAISE TOTALLING ABOUT SEK 10 MLN
CAPITAL RAISE WILL BE CARRIED OUT THROUGH PRIVATE PLACEMENT OF UNITS OF ABOUT SEK 6 MLN AND OFFERING OF UNITS WITH PREEMPTIVE RIGHTS FOR EXISTING SHAREHOLDERS OF ABOUT 4 MSEK
MEMBERS OF BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND MANAGEMENT INTEND TO INVEST A TOTAL OF ABOUT SEK 1.3 MLN IN THE PRIVATE PLACEMENT
SAME SUBSCRIPTION PRICE OF 2.31 SEK PER UNIT IN BOTH OFFERINGS
SUBSCRIPTION PERIOD IS SCHEDULED FOR OCTOBER 14–28
